task: Build and verify the Arcanea Living Codex and Creature Forge vertical slice.
surface: Responsive web registry, entity detail pages, and original-creature blueprint tool.
audience: Anime and premium fantasy fans, worldbuilders, authors, indie game teams, and AI-native creators.
first_read: Arcanea has a specific living creature world, and the visitor can leave with an original artifact they own.

references.label: Arcanea canon
references.reason: Locks the ten Godbeast names, Guardians, Gates, and elemental cosmology.

references.label: Arcanea visual doctrine
references.reason: Defines luxury cosmic myth-tech materials and world-media direction.

references.label: Arcanea visual media council
references.reason: Maintains the split between restrained product chrome and cinematic world media.

keep: Tracked cinematic Godbeast media as first-viewport evidence
Geist product typography with Instrument Serif used only as an editorial accent
avoid: Decorative particle fields as the primary visual
Frequency values in user-facing product UI
Third-party creature or card design imitation
direction.signature: Move from a museum-grade living entity to a portable creator-owned blueprint in one coherent journey.
system: Asymmetric media collage on the Codex hero
Search and affinity filters in restrained glass controls
Stable entity URLs with structured data
Ecology-first Forge with consequence before spectacle
Tracked WebP world media and token-based application chrome

asset_quality.why_premium: The interface uses tracked Arcanea Godbeast media already committed as owned world assets rather than placeholders or decorative filler.

artifacts.notes: Desktop production render inspected at 1440px: strong editorial hierarchy, restrained filter chrome, readable cards, no overlap.
Mobile production render inspected at 390px: single-column hierarchy, usable horizontal affinity rail, no overflow.
Mobile Kaelith entity inspected at 390px: image, profile, signals, and CTAs remain legible and unclipped.
Mobile Forge inspected after filling Aster Vale; form, live preview, prompt, copy, and download actions remain usable.
Downloaded artifact parsed and inspected; schema, private-draft status, and not-canon provenance are present.

checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Tier B tracked Arcanea WebP world media; product chrome remains token-based.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: Desktop 1440px and mobile 390px PNG exports inspected for Codex, entity, and Forge surfaces.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: No horizontal overflow at 1440px or 390px; no clipping or overlap; production routes rendered and Forge export exercised.

score.notes: Ships above the 26/30 gate: strong hierarchy, real tracked world media, clear interaction, responsive integrity, and canon boundaries. One point held for baked labels in inherited world assets; two held until media registry provenance and saved-world persistence are connected.

known_risks: Existing generated media provenance predates this feature and should later be linked to the central media registry.
Some inherited Godbeast images contain baked annotation text; future clean master exports should replace them while preserving the current page composition.
Forge output is local-only in v1 and is not yet persisted into a creator world.
